title: How is Hitler connected to Kermit the Frog?
description: Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Kermit the Frog, through two prime ministers, the Queen and a first lady.
hook: How is Hitler connected to Kermit the Frog?

links.line: In 1938, British prime minister Neville Chamberlain signed the Munich Agreement with Hitler, hoping to avoid war.
In 1940, Chamberlain's fellow Conservative, Winston Churchill, replaced him as prime minister.
On Victory in Europe Day, 1945, Churchill stood on the palace balcony beside young Princess Elizabeth.

image.file: File:Barack Obama Michelle Obama Queen Elizabeth II Buckingham Palace London.jpg

links.line: In 2009, Queen Elizabeth the Second welcomed Barack and Michelle Obama to Buckingham Palace.

image.file: File:General Dempsey, Kermit the Frog, and Michelle Obama (13115193523).jpg

links.line: And in 2014, Michelle Obama introduced Kermit the Frog at a White House screening of Muppets Most Wanted.
